## Notes

OPeNBooK, designer Yoot Saito; released 1994 (Japan as The Tower; Maxis published elsewhere); Windows, Mac, Saturn, 3DO; offices, condos, hotels, restaurants, shops; standard elevators span up to 30 floors, express full height; 100 floors above ground, 9 below; tenant stress; star ratings 1-5 then Tower (cathedral); terrorist bomb ransom, VIP visits, fires, pests.
